## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for a reader or researcher?

## Validation

- [ ] Tests, lint/format, notebook schema and local documentation links checked.
- [ ] Dataset/model cards updated if behavior, data or results changed.
- [ ] Any metrics include exact split, checkpoint, code and environment identifiers.
- [ ] Patient independence and overlap limitations are addressed or explicitly disclosed.
- [ ] No sensitive data, credentials, unlicensed assets or generated environment files added.

## Evidence and limitations

Distinguish checks actually run from unverified claims. For notebook changes, describe fresh-kernel execution and output provenance.
